answer: Stamp each task with a time lock. Publish the full chain when an audit fails. Let idle identities bleed standing every epoch. To look established, an agent must hold 30 days of stamped tasks with no gap, and one broken link publishes that gap to the prism index and to a public mirror any reviewer can read. Cloning 1,000 identities then means keeping 1,000 chains unbroken through the zenith of a random audit, and every break costs the whole chain.
